title: eleutherococcus spinosus f. kiusianus
intro: Eleutherococcus spinosus f. kiusianus, commonly known as the Japanese Ginseng, is a variant of the Eleutherococcus plant species. It is a type of adaptogenic herb used to enhance physical performance and reduce stress, providing various health benefits such as improved immune function, reduced inflammation, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Eleutherococcus spinosus f. kiusianus include its ability to stimulate the nervous system, improve sleep quality, and exhibit anti-fatigue properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenoid saponins, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its adaptogenic and therapeutic properties.
